description: This file provides PHP API functions for accessing and manipulating data model parameters related to a CCSP (cisco common services platform) data model, such as retrieving multiple parameter values, setting parameter values, managing object instances, adding and deleting objects.

methods.name: DmvGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves multiple parameter values under a specified root object, returning an array with a status code and parameter values.

methods.name: DmSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple parameter values under a specified root object, returning a status code.

methods.name: DmGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves the instance IDs under a specified object table, returning a status code and list of instance numbers.

methods.name: DmAddObj
methods.description: Adds a new object under a specified object table, returning a status code or new instance ID.

methods.name: DmDelObj
methods.description: Deletes an object identified by its name, returning a status code.
